USE ROLE tb_test_role;
USE WAREHOUSE tb_dev_wh;

SELECT
  cl.customer_id,
  cl.first_name,
  cl.last_name,
  cl.phone_number,
  cl.e_mail,
  cl.birthday_date,
  cl.city,
  cl.country
FROM raw_customer.customer_loyalty cl
WHERE cl.country IN ('United States','Canada','Brazil');
